summary.en: German reunification took effect on 3 October 1990 under the Unification Treaty. The five re-established eastern states joined the Federal Republic, and Berlin became the capital of the united country. The opening of the Berlin Wall in November 1989 had been an earlier turning point; it did not itself create a unified state.

title.zh: 蒙哥马利：组织公共汽车抵制运动

location.label: Montgomery, Alabama; representative city-center point

summary.en: After Rosa Parks’s arrest in December 1955, Black residents of Montgomery sustained a boycott of segregated city buses. The campaign grew from earlier organizing, including the Women’s Political Council, and relied on walkers, carpools, churches, fundraising and the Montgomery Improvement Association. Martin Luther King Jr. became a prominent spokesman, but the movement’s endurance depended on a much wider community. Legal action by women challenging bus segregation also proved crucial, with federal courts ruling against the system in 1956. The episode shows how everyday transport could become a field of political struggle, and how collective organization and litigation worked together to change public institutions.
summary.zh: 罗莎·帕克斯于1955年12月被捕后，蒙哥马利的黑人居民持续抵制实行种族隔离的市内公共汽车。运动建立在妇女政治委员会等组织此前的工作之上，依靠步行、拼车、教会、筹款和蒙哥马利改进协会维持。马丁·路德·金成为著名发言人，但运动能够坚持，有赖于更广泛的社区。妇女针对公共汽车隔离提出的诉讼同样关键，联邦法院于1956年裁定隔离制度违法。此事展示日常交通如何成为政治斗争场所，以及集体组织与诉讼如何协同改变公共机构。

dateNote.en: The boycott ran from 5 December 1955 to 20 December 1956; earlier organizing and arrests preceded it. The year interval includes the protest and legal outcome, not the entire civil rights movement.
dateNote.zh: 抵制从1955年12月5日持续至1956年12月20日，此前已有组织活动和逮捕事件。此时段包括抗议与法律结果，不是整个民权运动。

title.en: Reunited Germany: the end of territorial division
title.zh: 统一后的德国：领土分裂的结束

location.label: Berlin; representative reunion site

summary.en:
German reunification took place on 3 October 1990. The federal government’s contemporary-event chronology records celebrations in Berlin and the end of the country’s division. This gives the atlas a concrete transition to show: East and West Germany belong in the preceding context, while a year-end view of 1990 needs the reunited state.

The bar begins with reunification, not with the origin of Germany or with the founding of the Federal Republic. It is one political focus period among longer histories of language, settlement, citizenship and institutions. Compare the 1989 and 1990 map views, then follow the Soviet dissolution entry to see why major European changes must be dated separately rather than combined into one undifferentiated post-Cold-War moment.
summary.zh:
德国于1990年10月3日实现统一。联邦政府的事件年表记录了柏林的庆祝活动和国家分裂的结束。这为地图提供了一个可核对的转折：此前的背景需要东德与西德，而1990年年末视图应呈现统一后的国家。

这条时间带从统一开始，并非德国历史的起点，也不是联邦共和国的建立时间。它只是语言、聚落、公民身份和制度等更长历史中的一个政治关注时期。比较1989年和1990年的地图，再阅读苏联解体条目，就能看到欧洲的重要变化为何必须分别注明日期，而不能合成一个含混的“冷战后时刻”。

dateNote.en: The focus interval begins with reunification on 3 October 1990. The Federal Republic predates this interval. The ongoing period is capped at 2026; Berlin represents the reunion context, not a territorial survey.
dateNote.zh: 本关注时段从1990年10月3日统一开始；联邦共和国本身早于这一时期。延续中的时段暂列至2026年；柏林代表统一背景，并非领土测绘点。

zh: 1990年年末地图不同于当年年初。

title.en: Ida B. Wells · Investigating racial violence
title.zh: 艾达·B·威尔斯 · 调查种族暴力

location.label: Chicago; representative organizing and publishing setting

summary.en:
Ida B. Wells used journalism to challenge the excuses offered for lynching. After the 1892 murder of her friend Thomas Moss and two other Black businessmen in Memphis, she investigated the relationship between racial terror, competition and official complicity. A mob destroyed her newspaper office, but forced departure did not end her work.

Southern Horrors and A Red Record brought cases and statistics to a wider public. Wells lectured abroad, organized in Chicago and connected protection from violence to economic and political rights. She challenged racism within the women’s suffrage movement and helped build the Alpha Suffrage Club. Her investigations show how evidence could be assembled against an official narrative sustained by intimidation. Her organizing also placed working-class Black communities and women within a civil-rights history often told through later national campaigns.
summary.zh:
艾达·B·威尔斯运用新闻调查，挑战为私刑辩护的借口。1892年，她的朋友托马斯·莫斯及另外两名孟菲斯黑人商人被杀后，她追查种族恐怖、商业竞争和官方纵容之间的关系。暴民摧毁报社，但被迫离开没有终止她的工作。

《南方恐怖》与《红色记录》把个案和统计带给更广泛公众。威尔斯赴海外演讲、在芝加哥组织行动，把免受暴力同经济及政治权利相连。她挑战妇女选举权运动中的种族歧视，并参与建立阿尔法选举权俱乐部。她的调查展示如何搜集证据，反驳以恐吓维持的官方叙述；组织工作也把黑人劳动社群和女性，纳入常由后来全国运动主导的民权史。

dateNote.en: Lifespan 1862–1931; focus on investigative journalism and organizing, not a complete bibliography.
dateNote.zh: 生卒年1862—1931；关注调查新闻与组织工作，并非完整著作目录。

title.zh: 莉莉乌奥卡拉尼 · 主权、写作与歌曲

location.label: Honolulu; representative royal and political reference

labelI18n.en: Honolulu; representative royal and political reference
labelI18n.zh: 檀香山；王室与政治背景的代表性参考位置

summary.en:
Liliʻuokalani became Hawaiʻi’s reigning queen in 1891 and sought to strengthen the authority of the monarchy and her people. The overthrow of 1893 did not end her political activity. She opposed annexation through petitions, delegations and writing, while her supporters pursued different strategies to restore the kingdom. In 1895 she was imprisoned after an attempted restoration by some supporters.

Her 1898 autobiography offered her own account of the political crisis and challenged representations produced by opponents. Music was another form of cultural and political expression. In 1909 she established a trust for Hawaiian children, connecting her later life to care and education as well as sovereignty. Reading her own institutional legacy beside sourced historical scholarship avoids treating her only as the passive last figure in a monarchy’s fall. It also distinguishes a reigning queen from a royal consort and recognizes that political action continued after the loss of formal office.
summary.zh:
莉莉乌奥卡拉尼于1891年成为夏威夷执政女王，寻求增强君主制及其人民的权威。1893年的政变没有结束她的政治活动。她通过请愿、代表团与写作反对兼并，而支持者则以不同策略谋求恢复王国。1895年，部分支持者尝试复辟后，她被囚禁。

1898年的自传提供她本人对政治危机的叙述，挑战对手形成的形象。音乐也是文化与政治表达的方式。1909年，她为夏威夷儿童建立信托，使晚年生活同时连接主权、照料与教育。把其机构遗产与有来源的历史研究并读，可避免只把她当成王朝覆亡中被动的最后人物，也区分执政女王与王后，并认识正式官位丧失之后政治行动仍在继续。

dateNote.en: Focus 1891 accession through 1909 trust foundation, not her full 1838–1917 lifespan. The overthrow 1893 and imprisonment 1895 are different events.

title.en: Dolores Huerta · Organizing workers and households
title.zh: 多洛雷斯·韦尔塔 · 组织劳动者与家庭

location.label: Delano, California; representative farmworker organizing center

labelI18n.en: Delano, California; representative farmworker organizing center
labelI18n.zh: 加利福尼亚州德拉诺；代表性农场工人组织活动中心

summary.en:
Dolores Huerta’s early organizing connected conditions in agricultural work with the lives of children and families. Born in Dawson, New Mexico, in 1930 and raised mainly in Stockton, California, she trained as a teacher. The hunger and insecurity she encountered among farmworkers’ children helped lead her from the classroom into collective action. In 1955 she became involved in the Community Service Organization, linking local political participation to the needs of working communities.

Huerta co-founded the National Farm Workers Association with César Chávez in 1962. When Filipino workers organized through the Agricultural Workers Organizing Committee began the Delano grape strike in September 1965, the association joined them. The alliance depended on organizing across ethnic and organizational lines; neither a single leader nor a single community explains its achievements. Huerta helped build the boycott beyond the vineyards and negotiated with growers, making consumers and distant supporters part of the struggle.

The 1966 union merger and contracts won in 1970 translated mobilization into more durable institutions. Pay and working conditions were connected to protections, access to care and the practical demands of family life. Huerta also faced gender discrimination while asserting women’s role within the movement. Her work invites attention to the organizing, negotiation and unpaid care behind public demonstrations. This entry follows her formation and the grape-strike years through 1970; that endpoint is a historical focus, not the end of her life or activism.
summary.zh:
多洛雷斯·韦尔塔早期的组织工作，把农业劳动条件与儿童、家庭的生活联系起来。她于1930年出生于新墨西哥州道森，主要在加利福尼亚州斯托克顿长大，接受教师训练。农场工人子女的饥饿与生活不稳定，使她从课堂走向集体行动。1955年，她加入社区服务组织的工作，将地方政治参与同劳动社区的需要结合起来。

1962年，她与塞萨尔·查韦斯共同创立全国农场工人协会。1965年9月，农业工人组织委员会中的菲律宾裔工人在德拉诺发起葡萄采收罢工，该协会随后加入。联盟依靠跨族群、跨组织的合作，无法用单一领袖或单一社区解释。韦尔塔推动抵制运动走出葡萄园，并与种植业者谈判，让消费者与远方支持者参与斗争。

1966年的组织合并及1970年赢得的合约，使动员转化为较持久的制度。工资与劳动条件，同保障措施、医疗服务和家庭生活的实际需要相连。韦尔塔还面对性别歧视，同时坚持女性在运动中的地位。她的经历让人看到公共示威背后的组织、谈判与无偿照护劳动。本条关注她的成长及截至1970年的葡萄罢工阶段；结束年份不是她生命或行动的终点。

dateNote.en: 1930–1970 covers birth through the grape-strike settlement, not a lifespan. The selected milestones describe early organizing; later decades remain outside this entry’s focus.

title.en: Ho Chi Minh: exile, revolutionary organization and state leadership
title.zh: 胡志明：流亡、革命组织与国家领导

location.label: Hanoi; representative political centre

summary.en:
Ho Chi Minh’s political career developed through migration and revolutionary networks before he became a head of government. In 1911, using an earlier name, he left Saigon for maritime employment. Work and activism abroad connected an opponent of French colonial rule with communist organizations and with Vietnamese exiles. His activities in Guangzhou from 1924 illustrate the cross-border setting of that organizing.

In 1945 he proclaimed the Democratic Republic of Vietnam in Hanoi. Independence remained contested as French forces sought to restore authority and competing Vietnamese political projects persisted. A contemporary American diplomatic report from early 1946 records his appeals for outside support and his demand that French promises specify what independence would actually mean. The document reveals political argument and negotiation; it does not establish every assertion made in the appeals.

After the 1954 settlement he remained president in the north. His public prominence should not obscure collective party leadership or the changing distribution of decision-making power. He died in 1969, before the end of the war and formal reunification.

The selected life points connect travel, organization, declarations and diplomacy rather than presenting an uninterrupted march toward a predetermined outcome. Memorial accounts are useful for objects and chronology but also cultivate a heroic image. Reading them beside contemporary diplomatic evidence helps distinguish what he sought, what he claimed and what institutions could actually achieve.
summary.zh:
胡志明在成为政府领导人之前，其政治生涯已通过迁移与革命网络发展。1911年，他使用早年的姓名离开西贡，从事海上工作。海外劳动与活动，使反对法国殖民统治的他同共产党组织及越南流亡者建立联系。1924年起在广州的活动，展示这种组织工作的跨国环境。

1945年，他在河内宣布成立越南民主共和国。法国军队试图恢复权威，越南内部也存在竞争性政治方案，独立仍受到争夺。1946年初一份美国外交报告记录了他寻求外部支持，以及要求法国具体说明“独立”含义的主张。这份文件展示政治论争与谈判，并不能证实其呼吁中的每一项断言。

1954年的安排之后，他继续担任北方国家主席。其公众地位不应掩盖党内集体领导及决策权分配的变化。他于1969年去世，早于战争结束与正式统一。

所选生涯节点连接旅行、组织、宣告与外交，而非描绘通向预定结局的连续胜利。纪念性记述能提供物件与年代信息，也塑造英雄形象；与同时代外交证据并读，有助于区分他的追求、主张以及机构实际能够实现的事情。

title.en: Abraham Lincoln · Union, emancipation and unfinished freedom
title.zh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯 · 联邦、解放与未完成的自由

location.label: Springfield, Illinois; legal and political home, not every debate venue

summary.en:
Abraham Lincoln’s route to the presidency passed through self-education, legal work and competitive electoral politics. Born near Hodgenville, Kentucky, in 1809, he had limited access to formal schooling. Study and work carried him into Illinois law and the political world of Springfield. Service in the state legislature and Congress preceded a failed Senate campaign in 1858 whose debates brought him national attention.

His opposition to slavery’s expansion helped define his 1860 presidential campaign. Victory was followed by secession, and preserving the Union became his immediate war objective. The conflict nevertheless changed as enslaved people sought their own freedom, Black men entered federal service and emancipation became a Union military policy. These actions and pressures belong alongside presidential decisions.

Lincoln issued the final Emancipation Proclamation on 1 January 1863. It declared freedom in specified rebellious areas, exempting loyal border states and other named places. Its enforcement depended on military advances. It neither instantly ended slavery everywhere nor made freedom solely a gift bestowed from Washington.

Wartime government also expanded executive power, including restrictions on legal protections. Military victory and a second presidential term did not settle citizenship, land, education or equal treatment. Lincoln was shot at Ford’s Theatre in Washington and died on 15 April 1865, leaving those questions to a contested Reconstruction. His biography connects an extraordinary political ascent to the collective struggle that destroyed slavery and to the limits of what emancipation alone could accomplish.
summary.zh:
亚伯拉罕·林肯通往总统职位的道路，经过自学、法律工作与竞争性的选举政治。他1809年生于肯塔基州霍奇维尔附近，接受正规教育的机会有限。学习和工作使他进入伊利诺伊州法律界及斯普林菲尔德的政治环境。在州议会和国会任职后，他1858年竞选参议员失利，但辩论使他获得全国关注。

反对奴隶制扩张是1860年总统竞选的重要立场。胜选后南方各州分离，维护联邦成为他的直接战争目标。但战争也因被奴役者争取自由、黑人参加联邦军队，以及解放成为军事政策而改变。这些行动与压力应与总统决策一同理解。

林肯于1863年1月1日颁布最终《解放宣言》，宣布指定叛乱地区被奴役者获得自由，同时豁免忠于联邦的边境州和其他明确列出的地方。执行依赖军事推进。宣言既没有立即在全国结束奴隶制，也不意味着自由只是从华盛顿授予的礼物。

战时政府还扩大行政权，包括限制法律保障。军事胜利和第二届任期没有解决公民身份、土地、教育或平等待遇。林肯在华盛顿福特剧院遭枪击，1865年4月15日去世，把这些问题留给充满争议的重建时期。其生平把非凡的政治上升，与摧毁奴隶制的集体斗争及仅靠解放能够达到的限度联系起来。

sources.title: Emancipation Proclamation (1863)
sources.evidenceNote: Actual source text captured centrally through the root Codex in-app browser and read locally by the regional author. Historical explanation and proclamation transcript: preliminary measure 22 September 1862; final measure issued at Washington on 1 January 1863, limited rebellious areas and explicit exceptions, military dependence, Black armed service and enslaved people’s own pursuit of freedom. Does not say nationwide slavery ended in January 1863.
